### Data Story Example

*How could a **Data Story** look?* 

Webpage with report and Presentation: [CoviD Pandemic and Summerbreaks](https://janlorenz.github.io/summerbreakcovid/)

The slidedeck is the core deliverable: [Direct Link](https://janlo.de/presentation.html#/title-slide)

Analyse the core components of a Data Story. 
*This is not a perfect example, you can be critical.*

1. What is the main insight?
2. Who is the target audience?
3. What is the structure of the story?
4. What are the data sources?
    - List all what is necessary to reproduce the analysis
5. What metrics are used?
    - What new metrics are computed? List all. 
    - How is the raw data transformed mathematically?
6. Got through the slides one by one
    - What is the purpose of each slide? 
    - Is anything missing at the stage of the story? A slide needed before? What could be emphasized or removed?
    - On the Data Visuals: Is there clutter (unnecessary elements)? Is everything labeled? Are the colors used wisely?
    - On things not data: Do concepts, ideas, and story points become clear?


### Exploring the Playground Repository

*How can components of Data Stories be produced? (reproducibly)* 

Explore the GitHub repository [VisCom_Playground](https://github.com/CU-F26-MDSSB-MET-03-VisCommDataStory/VisCom_Playground). Clone it, do `quarto render`, open `_site/index.html` in your browser, and look at the four pages of the Website:

- Start Page: **Report**
- Bibliography Example: More **references**. Learn how referencing works. Side-quest: There is interesting literature on Data Visualization there!
- Presentation: **Slide-deck**
- **Scrollytelling**: A new option you can use to tell your story. (It can be used in parts of your report.)
